name: tickerwall
description: A self-hosted market terminal: 20 global instruments, terminator world map, macro event stream, correlation matrix and an interactive transmission graph. Zero runtime dependencies, one Node process.
//: 依赖只用于 `npm run build` 生成 public/vendor/macro-flow.js；产物已入库，运行看板本身不需要 node_modules。tslib 是 @antv/x6 的构建产物实际会 import 但没写进它自己 dependencies 的包，必须显式装上。elkjs 只给 tools/layout-lab.mjs 做离线布局实验，不进浏览器包。
